head.unknown: Your time is not on this tablet

breakDue: Time for a break: take at least 10 minutes.
breakLaw: After six hours of work a break is due, at least 10 minutes if no agreement says otherwise.

flag.FORGOT_BADGE: By name and PIN: your team leader sees it.
flag.CLOCK_SKEW: This tablet's clock looks wrong: your team leader checks the time.
flag.forgotten: The clock-in of {when} was never closed: your team leader corrects that day.

closed.title: Clocking is off at this site
closed.body: The clock stays off until the company has written its legal basis and given every worker the notice (Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4, c.2 and c.3). Nothing is recorded here.
closed.fix: Your hours are kept the usual way. Ask HR when it starts.

unavailable.title: The clock does not answer
unavailable.body: Nothing was recorded. Try again in a moment; if the network is down, the tablet keeps your clocking.

receipt.saved: Saved on this tablet at {time} (tablet time).
receipt.wrong: This badge or PIN does not open this tablet. Ask your team leader.
receipt.notBadge: That is not a badge. Scan your badge.
receipt.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then scan again.
receipt.unavailable: Nothing was recorded. Try again in a moment.

ALREADY_IN.fix: Clock out at the end of your shift.

NOT_IN.fix: Clock in first; your team leader corrects a clock-in that was missed.

ON_BREAK.fix: Come back from the break first.

NOT_ON_BREAK.message: You are not on a break.

ALREADY_ON_BREAK.message: You are already on a break.
ALREADY_ON_BREAK.fix: Come back from the break first.

BREAKS_FIXED.fix: There is nothing to clock for a break.

NO_EMPLOYEE.message: You have no employee record at this company yet.
NO_EMPLOYEE.fix: Ask HR to link your worker to your record.

OTHER_PERSON.message: This was clocked by another person on this tablet.
OTHER_PERSON.fix: It goes when they are signed in.

CLOCK_AHEAD.message: The tablet's time is ahead of now.
CLOCK_AHEAD.fix: Ask your team leader to set the tablet's clock.

scan.label: Scan your badge
scan.hint: A badge scanned here clocks in or out at once.

kiosk.title: Scan your badge
kiosk.body: One scan clocks you in or out. Nobody needs to sign in.

forgot.title: Pick your name
forgot.flagged: Your team leader sees that you clocked by name and PIN.
forgot.offline: Name and PIN need the network. Use your badge.
forgot.emptyTitle: No one is set up here yet
forgot.empty: Ask the office to set up the workers of this site.

problem.wrong: This PIN does not open this tablet. Ask your team leader.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute.
problem.unavailable: The clock does not answer. Try again in a moment.

choose.title: In or out?
choose.body: The tablet has no network, so it cannot tell. It saves this with its own time.
choose.notKept: This tablet cannot keep a badge safely. Clock when the network is back.

offline.unknown: Offline, with nothing read on this tablet: say in or out, and the office keeps it with the tablet's time.
offline.asOf: Read on this tablet on {day} at {time}.

kept.waiting_one: {count} clocking is saved on this tablet and goes when the network is back.
kept.waiting_other: {count} clockings are saved on this tablet and go when the network is back.
kept.refusedFix: Tell your team leader: they enter it by hand.

confirm.title: Clock out?
confirm.one: Your open bundle {bundle} will be paused.
confirm.many: Your {count} open bundles ({bundles}) will be paused.
confirm.next: Your next sign-in offers to continue.

open.next: Your next sign-in offers to continue.

noRole.title: Clocking is not for your role here
